summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY with embedded firmware experience on STM32 microcontrollers. Built real-time embedded software in bare-metal C and FreeRTOS: timer-triggered ADC sampling, interrupt-driven peripherals and closed-loop PWM motor control over UART/I2C/SPI communication protocols.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove for hands-free cursor control integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning PCB fabrication and hardware/software integration end-to-end.
Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Programmed peripherals directly in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1); achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at deterministic 1 Hz update rate; verified in Proteus.
Built Cortex-M4 microcontroller firmware in embedded C with timer-synchronized sensing and real-time display; interrupt-driven ADC sampling and low-level I2C driver.

projects.name: Robocon Competition Robot — Holonomic Drive & Encoder Odometry
bullets: Built closed-loop heading correction for a 4-wheel holonomic robot on Arduino Due: derived actual heading from dual-axis quadrature encoder odometry (2400 CPR, 2.9 cm wheels) and fed angular error back into rotation PWM, holding course during translation.
Implemented interrupt-driven quadrature decoding from first principles — a 4-bit A/B transition state machine on hardware interrupts — and drove four motor channels at 15 kHz PWM via DuePWM.
Added a fail-safe state machine halting all motors on controller disconnect; led coding team to Stage 3 of DD Robocon 2023.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination on STM32; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.
Implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands and user override; STM32 received control commands from YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson over UART.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided pick-and-place system with a Jetson+Arduino controller; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.
Integrated dual VL53L0X ToF sensors over a TCA9548A I2C mux for contact-aware grasping (gripper close at 25 mm); resolved 11 integration failures including servo brown-out.
